title: Balance Reconciliation
description: Extension schema for the vwp-accounting-reconciliation extension. Constrains a core calculation object of type 'balanceReconciliation': one reconciled scope (a wallet, an exchange account, a custody account, a bank account) at one date — the source balance and the ledger balance, each citing the fact it comes from, and the reconciling items that explain the difference. Located by type under calculations/; one calculation per scope and date.

scope.description: The reconciled account, wallet or custody scope label.

asOf.description: The reconciliation date; both balance facts must be stated as of this date.

sourceBalance.description: The balance per the source (statement, chain, custodian) in the currency.

sourceFact.description: Fact id whose value is {amount, date} stating sourceBalance as of asOf.

ledgerBalance.description: The balance per the general ledger in the currency.

ledgerFact.description: Fact id whose value is {amount, date} stating ledgerBalance as of asOf.

items.description: Reconciling items. amount is signed in the source-minus-ledger direction: the items with status explained sum to the explained part of (sourceBalance - ledgerBalance).

bookable.description: True when the ledger must record an entry for this item (errors and omissions); false for timing differences that clear themselves.

debitRole.description: Semantic account role debited by the adjusting entry (required when bookable).

creditRole.description: Semantic account role credited by the adjusting entry (required when bookable).

supportRef.description: The fact, evidence or calculation id that supports the item.

explained.description: Sum of the amounts of items with status explained.
